DOP: nibbuta mfn. [ used as pp of nibbāyati qv; cf S. nirvāṇa, S., BHS nirvṛta,], ( the various meanings overlap, and cannot (and should not) always be distinguished; see Ja I 60, 30* foll. below ); 1. ceased to burn, gone out; become cool, cooled; ceased ; D II 335, 12 (so ayoguḷo n’ eva tejosahagato hoti … sīto ~o); 341, 11 (kacci te tāta aggi na ~o ti); M I 487, 22 (sace … so aggi nibbāyeyya jāneyyāsi tvaṃ ayaṃ me purato aggi ~o ti); A III 409, 10 (aṅgārāni sītāni ~āni); Sn 19 (~o gini); Bv 2:92 (niraye pi … aggī nibbanti … te p’ ajja ~ā aggī); Mil 225, 19 (pāpakā akusalā dhammā tathāgatassa bāhitā … khīṇā khayaṃ pattā ~ā upasantā); 304, 9 (mahatimahā-aggikkhandho … upādānasaṅkhayā nibbāyati so aggi vuccati anītiko anuppadavo samaye ~o nāmā ti); 346, 22* foll. (~aṃ paṭhaviṃ disvā … anumāne jānanti mahāmeghena ~aṃ); Pj I 195, 7 (yathāyaṃ padīpo ~o evaṃ nibbanti); Th-a III 71, 16 foll. (yathā telaṃ ca paṭicca vaṭṭiṃ ca paṭicca pajjalanto pajjoto padīpo tesaṃ parikkhaye nibbāyati ~o ca katthaci gantvā na tiṭṭhati aññadatthu antaradhāyati adassanam eva gacchati evaṃ kilesābhisaṅkhāre nissāya pavattamāno khandhasantāno tesaṃ parikkhaye nibbāyati ~o ca katthaci gantvā na tiṭṭhati …); Thī-a 114, 22 (vaṭṭitelādike paccaye sati uppajjanāraho padīpo tadabhāve anuppajjanato ~o ti vuccati); — 2. ( i ) free from care or passion; serene, calm; happy ; Sn 630 (aviruddhaṃ viruddhesu attadaṇḍesu ~aṃ; Pj II 468, 19 : ~an ti nikkhittadaṇḍaṃ); Ja I 60, 30* foll. (~ā nūna sā mātā ~o nūna so pitā ~ā nūna sā nārī yassāyaṃ īdiso pati); 61, 3 foll. (kasmiṃ nu kho ~e hadayaṃ ~aṃ nāma hoti … rāgaggimhi ~e ~aṃ nāma hoti dosaggimhi mohaggimhi ~e … sabbakilesa-darathesu ~esu ~aṃ nāma hoti); V 119, 11´ (yadā pan’ assa hadayaṃ ~aṃ hoti mudukaṃ tadā vinicchayakammaṃ kātabbaṃ); Mil 347, 18 (~o ’smi bhante Nāgasena tumhākaṃ paramavicittena pañhaveyyākaraṇenā ti); Sv 147, 6 (~assa kho pana bhagavato santikaṃ ~eh’ eva yānehi gantabban ti); Mp II 138, 25 (indriyānaṃ santatāya ~-tāya paṇītatāya); Dhp-a I 223, 3 (idāni pana me cittaṃ ~aṃ bhavissati sukhena ca sayituṃ labhissāmī ti); Ud-a 250, 28 (hatthināgo … ghaṭasahassena nibbāpitasantāpo viya ~o hutvā pasannacitto); — esp. ( ii ) free from passion, in whom the fires of passion (the fuel for rebirth) have gone out ; Vin I 8, 24* (eko ’mhi sammāsambuddho sītibhūto ’smi ~o; Sp 964, 22 : kilesānaṃ yeva ~-ttā ~o); D II 136, 24* (rāgadosamohakkhayā sa ~o); M II 237, 13 (santo ’haṃ asmi ~o ’haṃ asmi anupādāno ’haṃ asmī ti); S II 279, 8* (anupādāya ~o dhāreti antimaṃ dehaṃ); A I 197, 8 (diṭṭhe va dhamme nicchāto ~o sītibhūto; Mp II 308, 2 : abbhantare santāpakarānaṃ kilesānaṃ abhāvena ~o); Ud 33, 20* (tassa ~assa bhikkhuno anupādā punabbhavo na hoti); Th 1060 (jhāyati anupādāno ḍayhamānesu ~o; Th-a III 139, 36 : rāgaggi-ādīhi ekādasahi aggīhi sattesu ḍayhamānesu saṅkilesa-pariḷāhābhāvena ~o sītibhūto); Thī 101 (pahāsiṃ āsave sabbe sītibhūtamhi ~ā); Ja V 251, 10* (upādānesu lokesu ḍayhamānesu ~o; 251, 20´ : ~o ti te aggī nibbāpetvā sītalena hadayena jhāyamāno); Ap 244, 22 (so ca buddhattaṃ sampatto ~o lokapūjito); 298, 19 (arahattaṃ ca me pattaṃ sītibhūto ’mhi ~o); Vism 513, 3* (atthi nibbuti na ~o pumā); — 3. gone out (like a lamp or fire); ceased, dead (without the possibility of rebirth) ; Vin V 216, 16 (na jīvati na mato na ~o); Vv 47:12 (tiṭṭhante ~e cāpi); Th 928 (sabbāsavaparikkhīṇā … ~ā dāni te therā); Ap 230, 22 (Siddhatthamhi bhagavati ~amhi narāsabhe); 244, 24 (~assa mahantassa citakam agamās’ ahaṃ); 542, 8 (pūjayiṃsu … ~aṃ buddhamātaraṃ); Mhv 2:32 (Ajātasattuno vasse aṭṭhame muni ~o); 3:2 (vesākha-puṇṇamāyaṃ so dīpo lokassa ~o); 3:41 (te yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā therā sabbe pi ~ā); — anibbuta , mfn. , not cool, not cooled; not calm; not free from passions ; It 91, 18* (It-a II 116, 20 : rāgādikilesapariḷāhābhibhavena ~o); Ja IV 391, 23 (tasmiṃ [pāyāse] ~e); Nidd I 448, 6 (samaṇabrāhmaṇā … ~ā nibbutavaṇṇena dissanti); Dhp-a II 166, 14 (kāyikapariḷāho ~o va); Nidd-a I 457, 18 (avupasantan ti ~aṃ); — sunibbuta , mfn. , 1. well cooled ; Vism 45, 19* (sālikūraṃ ~aṃ); — 2. completely gone out, extinguished; completely free from (the fire of) passions ; Th 1022 (khīṇāsavo visaṃyutto saṅgātīto ~o;
